description: Land Title Settlement Department - Diul Gahamula Wattha, Kadulla Pottha Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420202
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, ownership details, and property boundaries. It contains detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner information, land extents, and property classifications, which falls squarely under the Land Gazette category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
